Marie Taylira appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.

Involvement

Act Three

Marie Taylira shows up at the docks west of the Blushing Mermaid in the Lower City once all three Netherstones have been collected by the party. Once the party approaches, she is forcibly transformed into a Mind Flayer by  Ceremorphosis together with  Servant Asthena and  Tailor Vhynce.
